title: Nucleic Acid Purification - Workflow 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load deck layout and labware
steps.instruction: Place the following labware on the OT‑2 deck as specified: Opentrons 200 µL filter tiprack in Slot 5, Opentrons 1000 µL tiprack in Slot 6, VWR 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes in the Opentrons 24‑tube rack in Slot 2, NEST 195 mL reservoir in Slot 3, and 30 mL Caplug tubes in the Opentrons 6‑tube rack occupying Slots 1, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11. Ensure the robot is equipped with a P300 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette and a P1000 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette.

substeps.instruction: Place Opentrons 200 µL filter tiprack in Slot 5.
Place Opentrons 1000 µL tiprack in Slot 6.
Place VWR 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes in the Opentrons 24‑tube rack in Slot 2.
Place NEST 195 mL reservoir in Slot 3.
Place 30 mL Caplug tubes in the Opentrons 6‑tube rack covering Slots 1, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11.
Mount the P300 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette and the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette on the robot.

steps.title: Enter sample and pool parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, input the total number of samples (equal to the number of 30 mL tubes you will use), set the pool size to a value between 2 and 5, and specify the pipette mounts for the P300 and P1000 pipettes.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Click the download button to save the Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, navigate to the Protocols tab, and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Verify that the physical deck matches the layout described in the protocol file, placing each labware in the slots indicated.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, run the calibration routine for each labware piece, tiprack, and both pipettes (P300 and P1000). Follow the on‑screen prompts and use the recommended calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the Opentrons App to start the automated nucleic‑acid‑purification workflow.
